basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in the bustling city of Toronto, Canada. I work as a junior graphic designer at a local advertising agency, which fuels my passion for creativity and design. In my downtime, I enjoy exploring dog-friendly parks with my recently adopted Alaskan Malamute, Max. I have a keen interest in cultural studies and often find myself deep in discussions about international topics. Despite my busy schedule, I try to maintain a balance between work, leisure, and my growing interest in photography. My typical online hours are in the evenings and weekends. Currently single, but I'm open to meeting new people who share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design from a local university. My interest in cultural studies comes from a mix of formal education and self-study through online courses and documentaries. My knowledge about dogs and pet care is relatively new, acquired after adopting my own dog and through community forums and advice from fellow pet owners.
